_comment: General links not tied to one course. Each group has a label, an accent colour and links (title, subject, url, description). subject is a short tag used for the filter chips — CS, MATH, MISC, or anything else; chips are generated from whatever values appear. YouTube URLs get a thumbnail automatically. Course-specific links belong in courses.json instead. Optional Arabic: labelAr on a group, titleAr/descriptionAr on a link.
